verdict.rationale: Muse offers 'side chats' for separate context on topics as work grows complex and a Goals tab for tracking tasks, suggesting some contextual organization, but there is no explicit 'project/space' construct that bundles chats+files+shared instructions together. Missing for 10: explicit project/workspace container, file-attachment grouping, shared custom instructions across chats, and independent verification of how side chats share or isolate context.
